headline: Executive order creates a council to review how the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) works.
what_it_does: This order sets up a council to study and assess FEMA, the federal agency that helps with disaster preparation and recovery. No summary was provided, so details about who sits on the council, what it must report, and any deadlines are not available here.

who_it_affects.how: The agency's work and operations will be reviewed by the new council.

who_it_affects.group: People and communities that rely on federal disaster aid
who_it_affects.how: The review could lead to future changes in how disaster help is provided, though this order itself only creates the council.
